scope: Portlight iPhone viewer; existing Portlight protocol; no URC protocol or ZeroTier integration
instructions: Record command, artifact, device/runtime and date in evidence. A physical-device item cannot pass from simulator evidence alone. Preserve requirements; document an approved scope change instead of silently deleting one.

requirements.requirement: Source snapshot and destination differences recorded; no unrelated changes overwritten
requirements.expectedEvidence: source manifest, git status, progress note

requirements.requirement: iPhone simulator app builds and launches; test harness fails on zero executed tests
First-use trust approval and rejection; exact saved pin; changed pin stops reconnect
Cancel or new connection invalidates old trust decisions, frames, timers, audio and callbacks
No password is sent before certificate approval or read when merely selecting a saved connection
requirements.expectedEvidence: transport spy and Keychain adapter tests

requirements.requirement: Timeout, no route, refused port, wrong password and busy host have correct distinct outcomes
JSON/binary limits, overflow, malformed images, unknown codecs and invalid numbers fail safely
Fresh connection selects all three fixture monitors at revision 1 and fits the collection
requirements.expectedEvidence: real Portlight fixture transcript and screenshot

requirements.requirement: PNG4, indexed PNG8 and JPEG decode to correct pixels; overlapping partial updates preserve untouched areas
Applied patches remain complete when presentations coalesce; ACKs release old revision capacity
Frame arrivals never change viewport transforms; scripted trace is identical with and without tile flood
requirements.expectedEvidence: no-jump test with positive applied/presented counts

requirements.requirement: Direct, Trackpad and local Pan modes follow gesture arbitration and have visible state
Left/right/middle click, drag and modifier combinations reach the intended Mac display
requirements.expectedEvidence: controlled test-app input log and optical check

requirements.requirement: Buttons, locked/latched modifiers and keys release on pause, control-off, mode switch, background and disconnect
requirements.expectedEvidence: input ledger tests and physical mid-drag interruption

requirements.requirement: Unicode composition commits exactly once; special keys and hardware keyboard use keysyms
requirements.expectedEvidence: text/key event tests plus real keyboard check

requirements.requirement: Mixed-DPI, negative origins, portrait and 1+3 compact selection map correctly
requirements.expectedEvidence: geometry fixtures and physical mixed-display check

requirements.requirement: Fit follows rotation and available space; other zoom preserves anchor across resolution and keyboard changes
requirements.expectedEvidence: geometry tests and orientation UI tests

requirements.requirement: Control On/View Only is unmistakable; Pause dims retained picture and blocks remote input
Four resolution and three color buttons show selection; unsupported values disabled; no user FPS picker
Video smoothing is optional/off by default and does not affect Text mode
Offscreen selected displays have explicit zero regions; no unselected payload; no subscription during held drag/chord
AAC and mulaw bounds/formats decode; old audio epochs rejected; video-only revisions preserve playback
Audio continues across quality/display changes; bounded queue under congestion; route/interruption recovery
requirements.expectedEvidence: real phone playback and underrun/queue measurements

requirements.requirement: Background releases input and covers app-switcher image; foreground frozen frame reconnects without becoming controllable early
Names/groups/save/update/reorder/delete persist; credentials remain only in Keychain; selection does not connect
Explicit Type Pasted Text uses native paste intent and UTF-8-safe chunks; no clipboard polling
requirements.expectedEvidence: paste tests and device prompt behavior

requirements.requirement: Light/dark, large text, VoiceOver, reduced motion/transparency and 44-point controls are usable
Local network request/denial/retry works; no viewer screen-recording or microphone prompt
Named-phone local gesture timing, end-to-end input latency, bandwidth, audio and memory measured on named link profiles
requirements.expectedEvidence: benchmark report with method and samples

requirements.requirement: 30-minute phone session has bounded memory/queues and no stuck input across reconnects
Reproducible source/build, evidence, device test guide and honest limits delivered; no automatic publication
